base_requirements.combat: Elvarg level 83; Melzar and Lesser Demon plus four key holders in the maze. No fixed combat-level gate.

branches.map_parts: Thalzar's door, Wormbrain and Melzar's Maze can be completed in any order after the Guildmaster briefing.
branches.wormbrain: Modelled 10,000 GP purchase. Ranged or Magic kill and Telekinetic Grab is the omitted alternate route.
branches.shield: Duke Horacio supplies anti-dragon shield once briefed. The tradeable shield may have separate acquisition routes.
branches.shortcut: Opening the Crandor–Karamja wall is optional but enables persistent two-way travel to the volcano; the outbound Lady Lumbridge trip is one time only.

observations.thalzar: The Oracle identifies silk, lobster pot, unfired bowl and wizard's mind bomb for the Dwarven Mine magic door. Search the chest after opening.
observations.melzar: Maze key unlocks an ordered rat, ghost, skeleton, zombie, Melzar and Lesser Demon sequence. Collect the appropriate door keys, then the chest map fragment.
observations.lozar: Wormbrain in Port Sarim jail trades a map piece for 10,000 coins.
observations.ship: Klarense sells the Lady Lumbridge for 2,000 coins. Three holes require three normal planks, ninety steel nails, and a held hammer. Captain Ned needs the joined map.
observations.combat: Modelled successful fight with shield and 24-lobster combined reserve (8 maze, 16 Elvarg), conditional outcome. No combat XP credited because player combat method and encounter length vary. The owner should reconcile remaining consumables and incurred XP after each fight.
observations.rewards: Oziach's final hand-in grants two quest points and 18,650 XP each in Strength and Defence. The started flag marks earlier access to dragon Slayer assignments.
observations.travel: Bidirectional exterior links and the unlocked Karamja tunnel included; estimates use existing project walking timing. Maze exit and Dwarven Mine routing remain gameplay estimates.
